BiblicalUsage: The proud waters — the churning, raging flood — is the word's one appearance, in the song of deliverance. ‘Then the proud waters had gone over our soul,’ the psalm says, and the next line gives thanks: blessed be the LORD, who did not give us as a prey to their teeth. The waters rose, and God held the line.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the proud waters still rise, and the psalm still answers: the LORD does not hand His people to their teeth.
